blocks.html: Afterwards the said de Rols is made to come, who, as soon as she had cast her eyes upon the said newcomer, all in tears, and trembling like the leaf shaken by the winds, having her face all bathed in tears, ran to embrace him, asking his pardon for the fault which, through imprudence, and overcome by the seductions, impostures and wiles of the said du Tilh, she had committed.
